title: 2003 AMC 10A Problem 3
statement: A solid box is \(15\) cm by \(10\) cm by \(8\) cm. A new solid is formed by removing a cube \(3\) cm on a side from each corner of this box. What percent of the original volume is removed?

solutions.text:
The eight removed cubes have total volume \(8 \cdot 3^3 = 216\) cubic centimeters.

The original box has volume \(15 \cdot 10 \cdot 8 = 1200\) cubic centimeters.

The percent removed is \(\dfrac{216}{1200} \cdot 100\% = 18\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: There are \(8\) corners, and the original volume is \(15 \cdot 10 \cdot 8\)
